components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant call-to-action. Mar de Acuerdo background with white text. Use for the single most important action on a screen.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Companion action alongside a primary. Mar de Acuerdo text on white background with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; min-height: 40px; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #3F6F9E; border-color: #C9DCE7; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #F4FAFD; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background-color: #EAF6FD; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2F83C5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: For irreversible deletion. A calm, restrained red — deep text on a soft red background, never a bright alarm.

components.name: Card
components.description: The dominant surface primitive. White card on Hielo canvas — depth through tonal contrast, never a shadow. 14px radius, 24px padding, 1px hairline border.
components.html:
Título de la tarjeta

Descripción o contenido principal de la tarjeta. Puede contener texto, acciones, o cualquier contenido relevante.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #C9DCE7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.28; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #17324A; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: #526B7B; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Text field with label, optional hint, and error state. 44px minimum touch target, 10px radius. Focus shifts border to Cerúleo at 1.5px.
components.html: Describe brevemente la posición que deseas negociar
components.css: .ds-input-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: #17324A; } .ds-input-control { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #C9DCE7; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 14px; min-height: 44px; background-color: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-input-control:focus-within { border-color: #2F83C5; border-width: 1.5px; padding: 0 13.5px; } .ds-input { flex: 1; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: #17324A; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; padding: 10px 0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #93A6B1; } .ds-input-hint { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; color: #526B7B; }

components.name: Badge — Neutral
components.description: Small label for metadata and tags. Sunken background with muted ink text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; } .ds-badge-neutral { background-color: #EAF6FD; color: #526B7B; }

components.name: Badge — AI
components.description: Marks AI-assisted content. Turquesa Asistida text on aqua tint background. The only decorative use of the AI accent besides the AI button.
components.html: ASISTIDO POR IA
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; } .ds-badge-ai { background-color: #D8F2F2; color: #2F858B; } .ds-badge-ai-icon { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Status Pill — Success
components.description: Status indicator for completed/accepted states. Colored dot + text label — color is never the only signal.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 9px; } .ds-pill-success { background-color: #E1F3EA; color: #1F6E4F; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Status Pill — AI (with pulse)
components.description: Non-blocking AI-pending indicator. The dot pulses between 100% and 35% opacity over 1.6s.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 9px; } .ds-pill-ai { background-color: #D8F2F2; color: #2F858B; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-pill-pulse { animation: ds-pulse 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }

narrative.overview:
The Mediación design system creates a visual environment of serene professionalism — cool, clear, and considered. Every surface, color, and interaction is chosen to reduce tension and support deliberate decision-making. The aquatic palette draws from ocean depths and clear skies: deep, trustworthy blues anchor the interface, while the canvas breathes with the lightness of morning ice (Hielo). Nothing shouts; nothing distracts. The design recedes so the content and the mediation process take center stage.

The system operates on tonal layering — depth is a surface-color shift from canvas to card to sunken, never a shadow at rest. Shadows appear only transiently on overlays and popovers, and even then they are soft and diffused. Interactions are crisp and precise: border shifts on focus, subtle color changes on press, no bounce or looseness. The overall density is comfortable but efficient — generous internal spacing within components, tight grouping of related elements, and clear separation between sections.
keyCharacteristics: Cool aquatic palette: deep blues for ink, Hielo (ice) for canvas, white cards for content surfaces
Tonal layering over shadows — depth is a surface-color change, not a drop shadow
Crisp, precise interactions with immediate feedback and no decorative motion
Modest corner radii (6–24px) everywhere; pill radius reserved for status chips and avatars
Inter as the single voice for UI, JetBrains Mono for code and data
A reserved Turquesa Asistida accent exclusively for AI-assisted mediation actions

rules.name: The One-Color-Per-Concern Rule
rules.body: Turquesa Asistida (#2F858B) appears only for AI-assisted actions. Status success is a distinct green (#2F8F6B). Focus is a distinct cerulean (#2F83C5). No two concerns share a color; color is information, not decoration.

rules.name: The Canvas-First Rule
rules.body: Every screen's outermost background is Hielo Canvas (#F4FAFD). Cards sit on the canvas as Blanco Superficie. No screen uses a white background directly — the tonal ramp from canvas to card to sunken is the depth system.

rules.name: The Weight-Step Rule
rules.body: Semibold (600) marks headings and actions; Regular (400) marks body and metadata. Medium (500) is never used — two weights create clear separation.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth is a surface-color shift through the tonal ramp: Hielo Canvas → Blanco Superficie → Hielo Hundido. Cards rest at surface.card (#FFFFFF) on the canvas (#F4FAFD) background. Sunken sections sink one step deeper into surface.sunken (#EAF6FD). No surface carries a resting-state shadow.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state — dialog overlay, popover, or dismissible floating element. A resting shadow on a card is a bug.

dos: Do use tonal layering (canvas → white card → sunken surface) for depth — never a resting shadow.
Do use Mar de Acuerdo (#3F6F9E) for primary actions and navigational emphasis only.
Do reserve Turquesa Asistida (#2F858B) exclusively for AI-assisted actions, badges, and status pills — never repurpose it for generic success or decoration.
Do pair every status-pill dot with a text label so color is never the only signal.
Do pick a named content-width token (form 680px / reading 800px / standard 1040px / wide 1240px) per screen — never a raw number.
Do maintain the 44px minimum touch target for all interactive elements.
Do use Inter Semibold (600) for headings and buttons; Inter Regular (400) for body text. Skip Medium (500) entirely.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow to a card at rest. Shadows are transient — overlays and popovers only.
Don't use Turquesa Asistida for success confirmations. Success is Verde Acuerdo (#2F8F6B) — a distinct green.

Don't mix a primary (Mar de Acuerdo) button and an AI (Turquesa Asistida) button at equal visual weight on the same screen. AI actions are subordinate or absent; co-equal AI and human actions create ambiguity about who is in control.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons. Pill radius (9999px) is for status-pill dots, avatars, and tab toggles only.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure gray for text. The ink ramp (Tinta Profunda through Tinta Terciaria) is the only text palette.
Don't add a colored border-left or border-right above 1px on cards, callouts, or alerts.
Don't skip the canvas background — every screen's outermost layer must be Hielo Canvas (#F4FAFD). White backgrounds directly on a screen are a tonal-layer break.
